```{r }
pacman::p_load(rio,here, tidyverse, dpylr)

here()

cleaned_NHANES_data <- import("cleaned_NHANES _exercise4.csv")
```

The NHANES dataset is collected by the CDC and is a survey that assesses a participants (all ages) health and nutrition. This report focuses on the demographics of the data including Age, Gender, and Ethnicity and their relationship with Systolic Blood Pressure readings. 

### Preparing NHANES table 

```{r sample size based on wave, }
nhanes_sample_size_based_wave <- table(cleaned_NHANES_data$wave_id)

nhanes_sample_size_based_wave
```

```{r distribution of gender in each wave, }
nhanes_gender_distribution_based_wave <- table(cleaned_NHANES_data$gender,cleaned_NHANES_data$wave_id) 

nhanes_gender_distribution_based_wave 

gender_percents <- prop.table(nhanes_gender_distribution_based_wave, margin = 1) * 100

gender_percents

full_table_gender <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  `Sample size` = rowSums(nhanes_gender_distribution_based_wave),
  `Males n (%)` = round(gender_percents[, "Male"], 1)))

full_table_gender
```

```{r distribution of ethnicity in each wave, }
nhanes_ethnicity_distribution_based_wave <- table(cleaned_NHANES_data$ethnicity_2,cleaned_NHANES_data$wave_id) 

nhanes_ethnicity_distribution_based_wave 

ethnicity_percents <- prop.table(nhanes_ethnicity_distribution_based_wave, margin = 1) * 100

ethnicity_percents

ethnicity_table <- as.data.frame(cbind(n, 2015 = round))
```
